newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot gasoline steady, paper contango widens.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot gasoline steady, paper contango widens.

text.p: European spot gasoline prices were little changed but the paper market contango widened getting a boost from Wednesday's NYMEX unleaded gains and short-covering against possible Nigerian demand, traders said.

They said Wednesday's one cent a gallon jump in NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures put trans-Atlantic arbitrage opportunities back into focus, while an expected surge in demand for gasoline from Nigeria to cover a fuel shortage and tight high octane supplies in the Med gave the market a more bullish tone, despite quite lengthy avails in NWE.

The stronger sentiment was mainly reflect in forward paper swaps which jumped around $3 a tonne as shorts sought cover against the upside volatility. July, August and September contracts valued around $182.50 a tonne fob ARA.

On the key ARA barge market early trade was report at $187 for running refinery material in Rotterdam but the market was later assessed around unchanged at $181/$183 fob ARA as physical buyers stayed scarce.
Cargoes prices held steady with prompt Eurograde cargoes valued around $187 a tonne and regular around $178 cif NWE.
